'''Gratz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] forge master who operated the [[Gratz Foundry]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Boneyard (Nox)|Boneyard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nox (planet)|Nox]]. In [[25,793 BBY]], the [[darksider]]s [[Daegen Lok]] and [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] escaped from imprisonment on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Bogan]] and made their way to the Gratz Foundry, to construct [[Forcesaber]] weapons for themselves. On arrival there, Lok performed a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on Gratz that caused the forge master to believe that a pack of [[nashtah]] had entered his foundry and that if he stayed silent, the creatures would leave him alone. While Xesh utilized the foundry's facilities, Gratz sat crouched down on the floor in terror.
